arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users_with_online_txn FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users who have at least one online transaction, linking transactions to users through their cards.
assumptions: A user is counted through the cards they hold; transactions are linked to users via cards.user_id.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, since the question does not mention fraud labels.
